sloka: सो ऽबिवाद्य दशग्रीवं कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्।निर्जगाम गृहाच्छुभ्राद्रावणस्याज्ञया बली ।। ६.७८.५ ।।
transliteration: so 'bivādya daśagrīvaṁ kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam।nirjagāma gṛhācchubhrādrāvaṇasyājñayā balī ।। 6.78.5 ।।

translations.english: Greeting the tenheaded Rakshasa and going round him according to tradition, the mighty warrior went out from the abode early morning by the command of Ravana.
